title_as_printed: The Matagalpan Linguistic Stock of Central America
author: D. G. Brinton
journal: Proceedings of the American Philosophical Society
heading_as_printed: In the vocabulary, the words from the list by Noguera are marked with an N. Those not so distinguished are from the article of Mendoza.
place: Cacaopera, department of Morazan, El Salvador (Mendoza); Matagalpa and San Jorge, Nicaragua (Noguera)
heard: Noguera's list after 1853; Mendoza's article published June 1895
collector: Jeremias Mendoza; Rev. Victor Noguera (via C. H. Berendt)
about: Brinton combined words from Jeremias Mendoza's 1895 article on Cacaopera in La Universidad (San Salvador) with a list furnished to Berendt by Rev. Victor Noguera, curate at Matagalpa and San Jorge, marking Noguera's words with N.
